entries.text: 29.10.0 For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones: docker/cli, 29.10.0 milestone moby/moby, 29.10.0 milestone ⚠️ Potential breaking change: local registry connections If you explicitly configure insecure-registries in daemon.json or use --insecure-registry, Docker Engine no longer automatically treats loopback addresses (127.0.0.0/8 and ::1/128) as insecure registries. Warning After upgrading, pulls and pushes to local registries that use HTTP or untrusted TLS certificates may fail unless those registries are explicitly included in your insecure registry configuration. Configure TLS with a trusted certificate, or add only the required local registry addresses, such as localhost:5000, to your existing insecure registry configuration. When insecure-registries is omitted, loopback registries remain insecure by default. Setting "insecure-registries": [] in daemon.json disables all default insecure registries. moby/moby#53868 🧻 Engine API specification moves to OpenAPI 3.2 The Engine API specification now uses OpenAPI 3.2 as its source format, in api/openapi.yaml. A Swagger 2.0 specification generated from it is still published for existing tooling, in api/swagger.yaml. For the transition, this release also includes a Swagger 2.0 copy pinned to API v1.57, in api/docs/v1.57-swagger.yaml. Future API versions won't get a per-version Swagger 2.0 copy, so update tooling that depends on these files to use the OpenAPI 3.2 specif

entries.text: 1.57.0 Engine API specification moves to OpenAPI 3.2 Warning The Engine API specification now uses OpenAPI 3.2 as its source format, in api/openapi.yaml. A Swagger 2.0 specification generated from it is still published for existing tooling, in api/swagger.yaml. For the transition, this release also includes a Swagger 2.0 copy pinned to API v1.57, in api/docs/v1.57-swagger.yaml. Future API versions won't get a per-version Swagger 2.0 copy, so update tooling that depends on these files to use the OpenAPI 3.2 specifications. moby/moby#53630 Changelog GET /events: Container die events now include a restarting attribute, set to "true" when the container is about to restart, either from its restart policy or from a manual restart. moby/moby#50908 The attribute is omitted when the container won't restart, including during daemon shutdown. It announces the restart but doesn't guarantee it, because the restart can still be cancelled or fail. Fix the ImageManifestSummary.ImageData schema, which listed UnpackedSize as required even though that field doesn't exist. The unpacked size is reported in Size.Unpacked. moby/moby#53750 Migrate the Engine API specification from Swagger 2.0 to OpenAPI 3.2. moby/moby#53630

entries.text: 29.9.2 For a full list of pull requests and changes in this release, refer to the relevant GitHub milestones: docker/cli, 29.9.2 milestone moby/moby, 29.9.2 milestone Security The Go runtime update addresses CVE-2026-111943 by rejecting certificate chains that include eight revoked eMudhra intermediate certificates. Image pulls and pushes fail TLS certificate verification if a registry's certificate chain relies on one of the affected TLS intermediates. Affected registries need a replacement certificate chain that does not use these intermediates. The blocked intermediates are: Domain-validated TLS: EM DV TLS CA - G3B and EM DV TLS CA - G3C Organization-validated TLS: EM OV TLS CA - G3B and EM OV TLS CA - G3C Extended-validation TLS: EM EV TLS CA - G3B and EM EV TLS CA - G3C Code signing: EM OV CS CA - G3B and EM OV CS CA - G3C The G3B intermediates belong to eMudhra BV, and the G3C intermediates belong to eMudhra Inc. The keys for these intermediates were compromised. Packaging updates Update Go runtime to 1.26.10. moby/moby#53989, docker/cli#7418
